claims.text: Battalion announced an equity investment in Collide on September 8, 2026.
claims.statement: Battalion announced an equity investment in Collide on September 8, 2026.
claims.scope_note: Announcement date, not a new September 28 agreement.

claims.text: Battalion says it invested in Collide and entered a strategic partnership.
claims.statement: Battalion says it invested in Collide and entered a strategic partnership.
claims.quote: Battalion has entered into a strategic partnership with Collide, investing in Collide and assuming the role of Strategic Partner.
claims.scope_note: Corporate statement; no independent closing record or amount verified.

claims.text: Battalion says it will deploy the Collide Operations System under an executed subscription agreement.
claims.statement: Battalion says it will deploy the Collide Operations System under an executed subscription agreement.
claims.quote: As a Strategic Partner, Battalion will join Collide's product advisory council and deploy the Collide Operations System across its upstream operations under an executed subscription agreement.
claims.scope_note: Executed agreement is reported; deployment is prospective.

claims.text: Riggs is designed to connect Battalion data from PDFs, spreadsheets and legacy systems into one model.
claims.statement: Riggs is designed to connect Battalion data from PDFs, spreadsheets and legacy systems into one model.
claims.quote: Riggs is designed to answer from Battalion's own data, gathered from the PDFs, spreadsheets, and legacy systems where it's been stuck for decades, and connected into one live model for the business.
claims.scope_note: Design description; no completed integration or actual interface verified.

claims.text: The announced deployment begins with well files, land records, contracts and production history in a queryable business model.
claims.statement: The announced deployment begins with well files, land records, contracts and production history in a queryable business model.
claims.quote: The deployment begins by unifying more than 100 terabytes of well files, land records, contracts and production history into a single queryable model of the business.
claims.scope_note: Planned workflow. Data magnitude excluded from approved authored copy; intact quote is evidence only.

claims.text: The company describes a planned shared model that would let land staff see well production and a completions engineer see lease obligations.
claims.statement: The company describes a planned shared model that would let land staff see well production and a completions engineer see lease obligations.
claims.quote: And because everyone works from the same model, the land team will be able to see real-time production from the wells they administer, while a completions engineer can see the lease obligations that shape the next drilling decision.
claims.scope_note: Future capability; no actual employees, actual query response, or proven drilling decision verified.

claims.text: Battalion expects Riggs to reach its production engineers at approximately day 90.
claims.statement: Battalion expects Riggs to reach its production engineers at approximately day 90.
claims.quote: Riggs, Collide's AI work environment, is expected to reach Battalion's production engineers at approximately day 90.
claims.scope_note: Expectation only. No guaranteed date, current availability, or calendar conversion; day-zero basis not stated.

claims.text: Battalion sees a fit for Riggs at its Monument Draw development in Ward County, Texas.
claims.statement: Battalion sees a fit for Riggs at its Monument Draw development in Ward County, Texas.
claims.quote: Battalion sees Riggs as a natural fit for its Monument Draw cube development program in Ward County, Texas and in the continued efforts to consolidate accretive assets in and out of the basin.
claims.scope_note: Company assessment of future fit, not proof of deployment at a specific well.

claims.text: The investment announcement does not disclose financial terms.
claims.statement: The investment announcement does not disclose financial terms.
claims.quote: The financial terms of the investment were not disclosed.
claims.scope_note: Limit applies to this release; no independently verified investment amount.

claims.text: Battalion warns that performance, personnel adoption and successful integration are not assured.
claims.statement: Battalion warns that performance, personnel adoption and successful integration are not assured.
claims.quote: Collide is an early-stage company, and there is no assurance that its products will perform as expected, will be adopted by the Company's personnel, or will integrate successfully with the Company's existing systems and data.
claims.scope_note: Retain uncertainty; no achieved operational change verified.

claims.text: The company cautions that projected cost or cycle-time reductions may not be realized.
claims.statement: The company cautions that projected cost or cycle-time reductions may not be realized.
claims.quote: Any anticipated reductions in operating costs or cycle times are estimates that depend on data quality, workflow adoption and factors outside the Company's control, and may not be realized.
claims.scope_note: No measured savings, speed gains or production gains verified.

rejected.claim: Riggs is already in production use at Battalion.
rejected.reason: Release describes expected access; no current operational proof.

rejected.claim: Integration will succeed and deliver savings or faster engineering decisions.
rejected.reason: Forward-looking caveats deny assurance; no measured outcome independently verified.

rejected.claim: The investment amount or valuation is known.
Day 90 is a guaranteed launch deadline or a particular calendar date.
rejected.reason: Expectation approximate and day-zero basis unstated.

rejected.claim: Show actual Battalion workers using a verified Collide interface.
rejected.reason: No operational footage, actual UI or named user activity inspected. Use an explicitly illustrative connected-records model.

rejected.claim: Hundred-terabyte scale and market magnitudes establish success.
rejected.reason: Corporate figures not independently corroborated and unnecessary for workflow explanation; excluded from approved copy.

rejected.claim: The September SEC filing corroborates the Collide deal.
rejected.reason: Full September 16 8-K concerns NYSE listing compliance. No corroborating deal filing located in current submissions list.

rejected.claim: This is a new agreement today.
rejected.reason: Verified announcement date September 8, 2026; no September 28 movement.

independent_corroboration: Not established. Accepted story claims verified as Battalion corporate statements.
visual_scope: Explicitly illustrative connected-records model only. No actual interface, person, query result, production statistic or business outcome may be invented.
